printables.title: Who Took Santa's Sleigh? Printable Christmas Mystery Puzzle, Family Friendly
printables.hook: Santa's sleigh is gone, 4,000 elves are on the roster, and one of them took it. A printable Christmas mystery the whole family can solve on Christmas Eve. No murder. Sixteen clues, real evidence, and exactly one answer.
printables.description:
Santa's sleigh is gone, 4,000 elves are on the roster, and one of them took it. A printable Christmas mystery the whole family can solve on Christmas Eve. No murder. Sixteen clues, real evidence, and exactly one answer.

WHAT IT IS
A name-elimination puzzle. You get a roster of 4,000 elves, sorted by family name, and a case to read. Each clue tells you which elves to cross off, until one name is left.
• Start with the warm-up: 48 elves and 8 clues, about 10 minutes, with the answers on the next page.
• Then the main case: 16 clues in three chapters. Chapter 1 clears whole pages at once. Chapter 3 comes down to a handful of elves and some real thinking.
• Every clue comes from the story or a piece of evidence: a burnt note, a cookie sign-out sheet, a torn name tag, a cocoa mug and more.
• About 2 hours on your own, or about an hour as a family with the roster pages dealt out.

WHAT YOU GET (5 files)
• Who_Took_Santas_Sleigh_Case_File.zip: the case file in three editions, US Letter, A4 and a linked tablet PDF. The same pages in all three.
• Hints.pdf: three hints for every clue. Stop at the first one that helps. None of them give the answer away.
• Solution.pdf: the ending, and every step of the answer, so you can see exactly where a count went wrong.
• Case_Briefing.mp4: a one-minute film that opens the case. Watch it first.
• START_HERE.pdf: which file is which, how to print, and tips for tablets.

WHY THIS ONE
• A Progress Check page gives the number of elves left after every clue, so you know the moment something slipped.
• Three hints per clue, with no spoilers.
• A ten-minute warm-up case, so you learn how the clues work before the big one.
• A happy ending. No murder and nothing scary. Kids 10 and up can do every clue; younger ones can cross off names while a grown-up reads.
• Also in the case file: a Suspect Board for the last eight clues, a notes page, a detective certificate, cut-out badges and a coloring page for the little ones.

PRINT OR TABLET
• Print at Actual Size / 100%, one-sided. The roster is 50 pages of 80 elves; plain paper is fine.
• On a tablet, open the Tablet edition in GoodNotes, Notability or Acrobat and use a highlighter. Its contents page and the strip at the top of every page link to each section and every roster page.

PLEASE NOTE
• Digital download only. Nothing is shipped.
• The pictures in this listing show the Letter edition. Gallery previews carry a small watermark; your files do not.
• Illustrations were generated with AI from Penny Paws Printables prompts, then checked by hand.
• For personal use, and a teacher may print copies for their own class. Please do not share or resell the files.

Stuck, or a download problem? Message Penny Paws Printables through your Etsy purchase receipt with the file name and the clue number.

printables.description:
Your kid wants another squishy. With this one, they make it themselves: print a page, cut out the two pieces, tape them together, stuff it with tissue and squish.

This DIY squishy printable has 20 paper squishy templates, each one in full color and in black and white to color, plus a mystery squishy bag and a squishy shop to play with once the collection grows. It's an instant download, so the first squishy can be on the table tonight, and you can print a new one whenever they want another.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 20 paper squishies: Glitter Dumpling, Butter Block, Jelly Cube, Gumdrop, Taba Paw, Cloud, Nugget, Cheese Cube, Bread Loaf, Carrot, Jelly Ball, Crunchy Soap, Boba Buddy, Cupcake, Donut, Ice Cream, Mochi Bunny, Mochi Cat, Mochi Chick and Mochi Frog
• Two versions of every squishy: painted in full color, ready to print and cut, or in black and white for kids who want to color their own
• A front with the face and a back with its own little detail (a bunny tail, a curled cat tail, frog spots). Every back is the exact mirror of its front, so the edges meet when you tape them
• Palm-sized pieces, up to 4.5 inches wide, with a dashed cut line around each one
• 2 play pages: a fold-over mystery squishy bag with a collect-them-all checklist, and a squishy shop sign with 8 price tags

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
• Paper_Squishy_Workshop_Full_Color_Letter.pdf: the 20 squishies in full color
• Paper_Squishy_Workshop_Color_Your_Own_Letter.pdf: the same 20 squishies in black and white
• Paper_Squishy_Workshop_Play_Pages_Letter.pdf: the mystery bag and the squishy shop
• Paper_Squishy_Workshop_A4_PDFs.zip: all three PDFs again, sized for A4 paper
• START_HERE.pdf: printing tips and the steps

HOW TO MAKE ONE
1. Print at Actual Size / 100% on printer paper or light cardstock.
2. Color both pieces, or print the full-color page.
3. Cut out both pieces on the dashed line.
4. Tape them together, faces out, all around the edge. Leave a small gap.
5. Stuff with tissue or cotton, tape the gap closed and squish.
For the shiny look in the photos, cover the pieces with clear packing tape before you cut them out.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A PDF reader and a printer
• Scissors, clear tape and stuffing (tissue, cotton balls or plastic bags)
• Crayons, colored pencils or markers for the color-your-own pages

• Digital download only. No physical item, toys or squishies are shipped.

• Want the coloring books too? The Squishy Coloring Bundle has this workshop and both squishy coloring books in one download, for less than buying them separately.

ART AND USE
Illustrations were generated with AI from Penny Paws Printables prompts, then checked page by page. Every outline and cut line is drawn by code so the two pieces line up. These are generic squishy designs, not affiliated with any toy brand.

printables.description:
The scariest house in town is pink this morning, with daisies, balloons and a bouncy castle on the graves, and one of 4,000 ticket holders did it. A printable Halloween mystery the whole family can solve. No murder. Sixteen clues, real evidence, and exactly one answer.

WHAT IT IS
A name-elimination puzzle. You get a roster of 4,000 Fright Tour ticket holders, one street of Grimsby Hollow to a page, and a case to read. Each clue tells you who to cross off, until one name is left.
• Start with the warm-up: 48 Garden Society visitors and 8 clues, about 10 minutes, with the worked answers on the next page.
• Then the main case: 16 clues in three chapters. Chapter 1 clears whole streets at once. Chapter 3 comes down to a handful of names and some real thinking.
• Every clue comes from a piece of evidence: a glitter trail map, a costume-shop ribbon card, a pumpkin weigh-in sheet, a hardware receipt and more.
• About 2 hours on your own, or about an hour as a family with the streets dealt out.

WHAT YOU GET (5 files)
• Who_Painted_The_Haunted_House_Pink_Case_File.zip: the case file in three editions, US Letter, A4 and a linked tablet PDF. The same pages in all three.
• Hints.pdf: three hints for every clue. Stop at the first one that helps. None of them give the answer away.
• Solution.pdf: the ending, and every step of the answer, so you can see exactly where a count went wrong.
• Case_Briefing.mp4: a one-minute film that opens the case. Watch it first.
• START_HERE.pdf: which file is which, how to print, and tips for tablets.

WHY THIS ONE
• Thursday's Ledger gives the number of people left after every clue, so you know the moment something slipped.
• Three hints per clue, with no spoilers.
• Every clue comes from something Palm found. A glitter trail crosses off whole streets at once.
• A happy ending. No murder and nothing frightening: spooky, silly and made for kids 8 and up, parents and grandparents at one table.
• A one-minute film that opens the case.
• Also in the case file: Thursday's Shortlist for the last eight clues, a notes page, a detective certificate, cut-out badges and a coloring page for the little ones, half spooky and half pink.

PRINT OR TABLET
• Print at Actual Size / 100%, one-sided. The roster is 50 pages of plain black text, cheap to print; draft mode is fine.
• On a tablet, open the Tablet edition in GoodNotes, Notability or Acrobat and use a highlighter. Its contents page is a town map where every street is a link.

PLEASE NOTE
• Digital download only. Nothing is shipped.
• The pictures in this listing show the Letter edition. Gallery previews carry a small watermark; your files do not.
• Illustrations were made with AI from Penny Paws Printables prompts, then checked by hand.
• For personal use, and a teacher may print copies for their own class. Please do not share or resell the files.
